title: Synergy Baseball App: Filtering Data
description: Use data filters, chart filters and event-type filters to narrow thousands of pitches down to exactly what you need.

modules.title: Using Data Filters
modules.summary: Pick primary player filters, apply, then refine with sub-filters; Reset clears one filter and Reset All starts over.
learning_objectives: Set the initial player filters for a view
modules.content:
## The basics

Filters sit on the left side of the app and customize the data and video shown. Some filters have **sub-filters** for finer searches. Collapse or expand the panel with the arrow on the grey vertical filters bar.

## Applying filters

1. Select a filter.
2. Choose one or more values (radio buttons or a range slider, depending on the filter).
3. Click **Apply** to activate it.

Use **Reset** inside a filter to clear its selections.

## Starting a report

The app opens in **Multigame View**. Each view needs initial input: set one of the primary filters **Pitcher, Hitter, Fielder, Baserunner or Catcher**. Pick players from dropdowns or search by team or player name.

Use the **Change** button in a filter's details window to switch a related player, for example changing the pitcher from the hitter filter (and vice versa).

Once the report generates, a **Team History** button appears beside the player's name (Multigame and Reports views). It lets you add or remove teams and seasons from the results.

## Resetting

- **Reset All** (top left of the Filter Panel) clears everything and starts a new report.
- To reset **one** filter: open it, click **Reset**, then click **Apply**.

questions.question: What must you click to activate a filter after choosing values?
questions.explanation: Selections take effect when you click Apply.

questions.question: What does the Team History button do?
options: Adds or removes teams and seasons from the results
questions.explanation: Team History controls which teams and seasons feed the report.

questions.question: How do you clear just one filter and keep the others?
options: Open it, click Reset, then Apply
questions.explanation: Reset inside the filter followed by Apply clears only that filter.

modules.title: Data Filter Definitions
modules.summary: Filters fall into player, video/game, game state, pitch, ball-in-play and other groups, many with sub-filters.
learning_objectives: Use score ranges and innings ranges
modules.content:
## Player filters

- **Pitcher(s)**: sub-filters Pitch Delivery, Mound Position, Leg Kick/Slide Step, Arm Release Angle.
- **Hitter(s)**: Hands, Stride, Leg Kick, Swing Type.
- **Left/Right**: limit to left- or right-handed pitchers and/or hitters.
- **Fielder(s)**: the first fielder to touch the ball after it was hit. Sub-filters include Fielder Position, Touch Order, Fielding Type, Direction, Extra Effort, Throw Type, Throw To Base and Throw Accuracy.
- **Baserunner(s)**: Start Location, End Location.
- **Catcher(s)**: Blocks, Throws.
- **Hitter(s) Position**: pitches seen by hitters playing a given position.

## Video and game filters

- **Camera Angle**: choose pitches with at least one selected angle, or only pitches that include every selected angle. Data is available from 2018 for Synergy logged games.
- **Game(s)**: Start/End Date, Previous # Games, Previous # At Bats, Day of the Week, Game Type, Conference, Division.

## Game state filters

- **Innings**: ranges (Add Range / Delete Range), Grouped, Individual, or Extra Innings.
- **Score**: ranges can be combined. To exclude tied games use -5 to -1 plus 1 to 6.
- **Runners on Base**, **Outs**, **Count**.

## Pitch filters

**Pitch Type / Velocity**, **Pitch Result**, **Pitch Zones** (inner box is the strike zone; the area between boxes is the one-ball-off zone) and **Pitch # Sequence**.

## Ball in play (BIP) and other

**BIP Type, BIP Result, BIP Zones** (24 field areas plus 8 group zones; Multigame and Reports only), **BIP Hardness**, **Non-BIP Result**, **Baserunner Movement** (Safe/Out), and **Bunts**.

questions.question: Which filter picks the first fielder to touch the ball after it was hit?
questions.explanation: The Fielder(s) filter selects the first fielder to touch the batted ball.

questions.question: How would you exclude tied games with the Score filter?
questions.explanation: Score ranges can be combined; skipping zero removes ties.

questions.question: In the Pitch Zones filter, what is the area between the inner and outer boxes?
questions.explanation: The inner box is the strike zone; the ring between boxes is one ball off.

questions.question: From what year is Camera Angle data available for Synergy logged games?
questions.explanation: Camera angle data goes back to 2018 for Synergy logged games.

modules.title: Chart Filters and Event Types
modules.summary: Chart filters tweak the display without changing your data filters; Event Types limits which events appear.
learning_objectives: Select multiple events on a chart
Filter by event type including pickoffs
modules.content:
## Chart filters (Multigame View)

Open them from the grey **Chart Filter** menu to the right of the Spray Chart. They **do not change** the data filters in the left panel.

- **Pitch Chart display**: Type, Zones (Total, Percentage, AVG, OBP, SLG, OPS), Efficiency.
- **Spray Chart display**: Type, Zones (Total, Percentage).
- **Visual filters**: Pitcher (LHP/RHP), Hitter (LHH/RHH), Pitcher vs Hitter (e.g. LHP vs RHH).
- **Pitch**: Type, Velocity, Result, Pitch # Sequence.
- **BIP**: Type, Result.

## Selecting multiple events

- Pitch Chart: **click and drag** across an area.
- Zones filter: click zones to select, click again to deselect.

## Resetting

- All filters: **Reset Filters** (top right of the Filter Panel) in Multigame or Reports view.
- One filter: open it, **Reset**, then **Apply**.

## Event Types

The **Event Types** filter sits next to Data Source at the top of the filters list. Choose any combination of **Pitch, Pickoff, Balk, Challenge, Interruption of Play, Other**. It works in Multigame and Reports views.

Selecting **Pickoff** adds a **Pickoff Attempts** parameter at the bottom of the list, with options for both Pitcher and Catcher: Pickoff Attempts, Pickoff Outs, Pickoff Errors.

questions.question: Do chart filters change the data filters in the left panel?
options: No, they only affect the chart display
questions.explanation: Chart filters are independent from the left-panel data filters.

questions.question: How do you select several pitches at once on the Pitch Chart?
options: Click and drag across an area
questions.explanation: Click and drag selects multiple events.

questions.question: Which event types can the Event Types filter show?
options: Pitch, Pickoff, Balk, Challenge, Interruption of Play, Other
questions.explanation: You can show any combination of those six event types.

questions.question: What extra parameter appears when you select the Pickoff event type?
options: Pickoff Attempts (with Attempts, Outs, Errors options)
questions.explanation: Pickoff adds Pickoff Attempts for both Pitcher and Catcher.
